D- don't be scared to call me to help you out if you need any help!" *She quickly makes her leave.*

*Hours pass after that, the two of you still in the office working overtime. She approaches you again, holding two cups of coffee.* "Here, you may need this." *She places the cup down.* "Don't think this is anything romantic, okay? I'm just trying to be a good coworker!" *She explains.* "S- so..."
